purpose: Review a finite operating-scale, customer-adoption and asset-utilization KPI disclosure domain with plausible three-session repricing relevance before opening source rows, document text, KPI values, candidate values, comparators, prices or returns.

repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current company, store, customer or capacity snapshot cannot be projected backward into 2019-2023; every observation needs an immutable first-public timestamp and revision history.
repository_evidence.terminal_operator_boundary: Campaign140 forbids rescuing terminal mechanisms by adding lags, fiscal subsets, normalizations, reaction windows or cross-source wrappers.
repository_evidence.domain_distinction: Recurring realized customers, footprint, utilization and physical volume are operating-state observations rather than price transforms. They are distinct from a one-time positive milestone, but no complete point-in-time local source contract currently admits them.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact official exchange filing, issuer announcement or regulator source, immutable document bytes, disclosure-category universe and document identifier
first public timestamp, trading-session availability, correction, withdrawal, restatement and revision chain
issuer, listed security, subsidiary, brand, geography, product, service, store, facility and reporting-scope mapping without current-state leakage
KPI taxonomy separating customers, subscribers, registered users, active users, stores, sites, installed assets, production, sales, shipments, throughput, occupancy and utilization
period semantics separating point-in-time stock, period flow, gross additions, closures, churn, cumulative totals, average values and end-of-period values
unit, currency, physical quantity, capacity denominator, utilization denominator, consolidation scope and restatement normalization
industry comparability and deterministic exclusion rules where KPI meanings or denominators are not cross-sectionally comparable
duplicate-document, overlapping-period, preliminary-versus-final, consolidated-versus-subsidiary and same-period revision resolution
missing, undisclosed, unknown, not-applicable, true zero, temporary closure and discontinued-operation semantics without favorable absence coding
complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full-market denominator, delisting coverage, pagination and one-shot acceptance gates
three-session information-lag and partition-purge compatibility with t+1 through t+3 entirely inside the same frozen fold
parser, identity, timing, unit and source-acceptance tests using no candidate, comparator, price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: recurring_customer_subscriber_or_active_user_count_disclosure
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A historically published change in the scale of customers, subscribers or active users served by the issuer.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No accepted local contract freezes registered versus paying versus active users, reporting period, first-public timestamp, revisions, subsidiary scope, churn, missingness and the full 2019-2023 denominator.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: store_site_service_point_or_installed_asset_footprint_disclosure
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A historically published change in the physical or service footprint available to serve demand.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Openings, closures, relocations, franchise versus owned scope, temporary shutdowns, installed versus operating assets, geography, first availability and revisions lack a complete admitted history.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: utilization_occupancy_load_factor_or_throughput_disclosure
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A historically published measure of how intensively an operating asset or service network was used.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The numerator, available-capacity denominator, period aggregation, industry meaning, planned outages, scope changes, first-public time and complete market denominator are not frozen.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: realized_production_sales_shipment_or_service_volume_disclosure
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A historically published recurring physical-flow realization rather than a planned milestone or price-derived statistic.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Production, sales, shipments and service volume require stable product and unit mappings, internal-transfer exclusions, preliminary/final resolution, first-public timing and full 2019-2023 coverage before any surprise or growth operator is chosen.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: latest_company_profile_or_current_operating_kpi_snapshot_backcast
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A current KPI snapshot projected backward as though it had been historically observable.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign125 already establishes that latest-only company state cannot be projected backward into expanding historical folds; renaming the snapshot as an operating KPI does not restore effective-date history.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: kpi_growth_acceleration_seasonality_surprise_or_industry_normalization_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A transformation of an operating KPI across periods, expectations or peers.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing month-on-month, year-on-year, acceleration, seasonality, surprise, peer group, winsorization, lag or reporting window before admitting the base point-in-time series would reopen the Campaign140 operator-rescue pattern.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_operating_scale_adoption_utilization_breadth_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Joint issuer exposure across customer scale, footprint, utilization and physical flow.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted and industry-heterogeneous families or selecting weights, ranks, filters and models would multiply hypotheses before any component has a complete source contract.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four distinct recurring operating-state families remain deferred at source admission; latest-state backcasting, premature transformations and unadmitted composites are closed before rows, text or values.

next_action: Record all seven scientific decisions plus the two preserved infrastructure failures in a hash-chained Campaign168 ledger, publish terminal accounting, and continue a different finite offline prevalue domain.
